summary: Paranovus Entertainment Technology Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a $10 million registered direct offering. On June 15-16, 2026, the company sold 9,300,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.20 per share and pre-funded warrants to purchase 40,700,000 shares at $0.1999 per warrant (exercise price $0.0001). No board recommendation or advisor (A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners acted as financial advisor, receiving 7% cash fee plus up to $50,000 expenses). Directors, officers, and >10% shareholders entered 45-day lock-up agreements. The offering, structured as a shelf takedown under Form F-3, provides working capital. Though a capital raise, its classification as a special-situation 'Capital Returns' is tentative as the filing does not clearly convey a return-of-capital event; the issuer has discretion over proceeds. Watch for dilution impact from warrant exercise (overhang) and any future restrictive covenant compliance.
